difficulty_reason: The lemma records the two basic source classes of the ind-quasi-affine notion: every quasi-affine morphism, and every immersion (open, closed, locally closed) is ind-quasi-affine. The retained proof is written: quasi-affine implies the test-class property immediately from the definitions (every quasi-compact open restriction of a quasi-affine map stays quasi-affine); hence affine morphisms and closed immersions are covered; the composition law (chapter lemma ind-quasi-affine-composition, card L16116) reduces a general immersion to its open piece composed with a closed piece, and an open immersion is ind-quasi-affine directly from the definitions since quasi-compact opens of the source pull back to quasi-compact opens mapping to affine pieces quasi-affinely. Retained author proof at lines 19611-19618.

dedup.scope: Membership of quasi-affine maps and immersions in the ind-quasi-affine class.
